QuestInfo.name: [Riena Strait] Back to Base 3
QuestInfo.1: You found out that #bFrostwitch Barbara#k is not the culprit. Return to #bPutan#k at the #bGlacial Observatory#k.
QuestInfo.2: You found out that #bFrostwitch Barbara#k is not the culprit and took the news back to #bPutan#k.

0.0: Ya wanna know why I keep this racket up, even though #reverybody hates me#k?
0.1: Used to be, those Penguins, Malamutes, and Seals couldn't stand one another. They were fightin' all the time, makin' a mess of things...
0.2: Then it just stopped. Can't say what sparked it, but suddenly all they could think about was catchin' the witch! Turns out that was me, even though I've been feedin' their young'uns.
0.3: At first I was mad at 'em. Thought about paddling every one of their bottoms raw...
0.4: But then I realized it was for the best. As long as they's after me, they ain't after each other. It ain't the best kinda peace, but it's peace nonetheless.
0.5: So, there's yer story, and you'd best keep a lid on it. It's not me you're after.

yes.0: Why don't ya do something useful and find the #rreal culprit#k?\r\n#b#e(Return to Putan at the Glacial Observatory.)#k\r\n

no.0: You need something else, or ya just here for a peek?

yes.0: You tell me witch is good. Now I do not know what to believe! Is madness!

npc.0: Why don't ya do something useful and find the #rreal culprit#k?\r\n#b#e(Return to Putan at the Glacial Observatory.)\r\n
